`life248.json.gz` is an exact selected-data export from
`life248-game-live-evidence-20261108.tar.gz` (SHA256
`711d89d106f3a7432a4f75292876ccb396da1b07e9edee5ad3d40fec5c044bf0`).
Keys are original `off/turns/NNN` directories; before states come from
